conventions.convention: The metric has signature (-,+,+,+), u is future unit timelike with g(u,u)=-1, and Δ projects orthogonally onto u⊥. Length coordinates satisfy x⁰=ct; u is dimensionless and physical heat flux is q=cQ.
A local state uses e∈C²(X), with X a nonempty open subset of (0,∞)×ℝ, and a C² state map (v,σ_p). It defines n=1/v, s=nσ_p, ε=ne, T=e_σ_p, p=-e_v, H=e+pv, h=nH, and μ=H-Tσ_p.
Exterior contraction means ι_uω=ω(u,·); P=(H/c)u♭ and the material-loop parameter satisfies ∂_λΦ_λ=u. Circulation conservation requires σ_p constant on the swept region; Dσ_p=0 alone is insufficient.
Shear uses averaged symmetrization and subtracts θΔ_ab/3. The entropy current is S=su+Q/T-μV/T, with spatial Q,V and symmetric spatial trace-free π.
The nonnegative residual requires u_bf^b=0. The Fourier witness is externally supported on t>0, whereas the growing Eckart witness concerns homogeneous linearized equations with f=0.
Countable Choice AC_ω is carried through the geometric and heat-kernel supplier chains; no stronger choice principle is asserted.

load_bearing.statement: For the stated Lorentzian state with n,T>0, spatial Q,V, symmetric spatial trace-free π, T^{ab}=εu^au^b+(p+Π)Δ^{ab}+u^aQ^b+Q^au^b+π^{ab}, J^a=nu^a+V^a, and balances ∇_aT^{ab}=f^b and ∇_aJ^a=0, S^a=su^a+Q^a/T-μV^a/T satisfies ∇_aS^a=-(Πθ+π^{ab}σ_ab)/T-Q^a(∇_aT+Ta_a)/T²-V^a∇_a(μ/T)-u_bf^b/T.

For the stated smooth Lorentzian perfect-fluid data with n,T>0, ∇_aT^{ab}=f^b is equivalent to Dε+hθ=-u_bf^b and ha^c+Δ^{ca}∇_ap=Δ^c{}_bf^b; ∇_aJ^a=0 is equivalent to Dn+nθ=0. Whenever both balances hold, T∇_a(su^a)=-u_bf^b and nT Dσ_p=-u_bf^b.

For the supplied perfect-fluid state with f=0 and n,T>0, P=(H/c)u♭, and a smooth closed curve transported by a local flow defined near its compact image, ι_u d(Hu♭)=T dσ_p and dC/dλ=c⁻¹∫_{γ_λ}T dσ_p. Consequently, circulation is conserved if σ_p is constant on the region swept out by the loop.

seams_checked.note: The state definition, Gibbs/Euler identities and frame decomposition were checked against their current draft carriers. The assigned items preserve their domains, C² state hypotheses, normalization and signs; the null example uses the decomposition clause and independently proves its obstruction.

The page and pthm-tgr-perfect-entropy-circulation use isolated perfect balances with n,T>0 and the exact compact-loop/local-flow hypotheses. They retain the restriction on circulation conservation and distinguish adopted physical assumptions from conditional mathematical deductions.

lem-tgr-perfect-linear-causality uses the no-force projected equations at a homogeneous reference state. lem-tgr-bulk-relaxation-entropy uses the perfect projection with the explicitly reconstructed bulk force and the dissipative identity with Q=V=π=0. These uses preserve the supplier signs and balance hypotheses.

lem-tgr-eckart-entropy-specialization supplies smooth state and transport fields, V=0, spatial Q, symmetric spatial trace-free π and u_bf^b=0. Its substitution preserves q=cQ, the entropy-current sign and all factors of c and T.
